newsitem.title: FINLAND: SKANSKA IN TALKS FOR FIM 1.2 BLN ROAD DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SKANSKA IN TALKS FOR FIM 1.2 BLN ROAD DEAL.

text.p: The Finnish road authority said on Friday it had chosen Nelostie Oy, a unit of Swedish builder Skanska Ab, for further talks on a 1.2 billion markka contract for the funding of a new highway from Jarvenpaa to Lahti.
"On the basic of the basic tender, the fixed-price value of the contract is about 1.2 billion markka," the Finnish National Road Administration said in a statement.
The decision to award the final contract would depend on the outcome of the next round of talks, it said.
A road authority spokesman said the contract under discussion with road company Nelostie was for services, while the company itself would make its own contracts for actual construction of the road.
"Nelostie Oy's tender is economically the most competitive. It is based on domestic and Nordic loan arrangements," the road authority said in the statement.
The bid to be discussed in further talks would be for a contract period of 15 years, it said.
Nelostie Oy was formed by Swedish Skanska Ab and its Finnish subsidiary Skanska Oy and Tekra-yhtiot.
Plans call for an agreement to be signed in February and for building of the road to begin in May, the road authority said.
The four other bidders for the contract were:

Ryhma vt 4, backed by Spanish group Dragados ; French group Bouygues; Suomen Laatutiet Oy, backed by Swedish NCC Ab; and Vianova Oy, owned by Finnish YIT-yhtyma and Lemminkainen and Finnish state-owned oil company Neste Oy, the road authority said earlier.
